title: Rogan's offline explanation of Lazar's deleted MIT records

tellings.quote: whenever he comes up with Rogan, Rogan always says, "Oh, I'll tell you something offline where like it would make the MIT records being deleted make sense."

plain: The podcaster Joe Rogan is said to have a private explanation for why the MIT records of Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft in Nevada in the 1980s, seem to have been deleted. Michels passes this on as something he has heard: whenever Lazar comes up with Rogan, Rogan says, "Oh, I'll tell you something offline" that would make the deleted MIT records make sense. Michels does not say what that explanation is, but it would bear on whether Lazar's missing education was erased on purpose.
